wish: someone should make a tool that opens epub files
spec:
Opens an .epub on the device: unzips it locally and shows the chapters with a table of contents.
Pick or drop a file, read, use Contents, Prev/Next and A-/A+; your place in each book is remembered.
Does not upload anything, does not open DRM-protected books, and does not keep the book itself after you close the page.
notes: Unzips with the browser DecompressionStream. Sample button builds a small deflated epub of public-domain opening lines in memory to exercise the same path.
